crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:eb.title: Staff Accountant
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:eb.description: Staff Accountant The Staff Accountant is a precise, analytical contributor to Crest Operations' Corporate Accounting & Finance team. The role independently owns recurring accounting work, applies GAAP and established controls, and produces complete, well-supported financial information. The successful individual works patiently and methodically, investigates variances to root cause, and communicates conclusions in a direct, factual manner. Success requires sustained focus, disciplined follow-through, sound judgment, and an exceptional commitment to accuracy, documentation, and consistent process. RESPONSIBILITIES Own assigned month-end close activities; complete each accurately and on schedule. Prepare timely, accurate financial statements and audit-ready supporting schedules. Reconcile general ledger accounts to system data; investigate discrepancies through resolution. Perform the monthly aircraft audit; document findings and exceptions. Support accounts payable while maintaining segregation of duties and internal controls. Prepare schedules and support annual audit requests. Analyze period variances and provide concise, fact-based explanations. Record journal entries and system imports with complete support, correct coding, and GAAP and policy compliance. Serve as liaison between corporate and division accounting teams; communicate requirements and findings directly. Master system and process details; implement approved improvements without compromising controls. Maintain current policies and procedures for standardized, repeatable work. Own ad hoc analysis and special projects within defined priorities and deadlines. REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's degree in Accounting required. At least two years of accounting experience, including month-end close and general ledger reconciliation. Working knowledge of GAAP, internal controls, account reconciliation, and audit support. Strong Excel and Windows application skills; ERP system experience required. Ability to analyze detailed data, troubleshoot discrepancies, and draw sound conclusions from evidence. Exceptional attention to detail, disciplined documentation, and adherence to established standards. Ability to work autonomously, maintain focus, meet recurring deadlines, and follow work through completion; communicates in a concise, factual, and professional manner.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:cd4.title: Store Floor Lead (Sur La Table)
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:cd4.team: 171 Darien - Sur La Table, 102 heights Road, Darien, CT 06820
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:cd4.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Store Floor Lead at Sur La Table, you play a key role in the success of the retail store by inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. In this leadership role, the StoreFloor Lead supports the General Manager (GM) or Store Manager (SM) in achieving sales and operational goals. As a key driver of in-store performance, Store Floor Lead serves as the Manager on Duty (MOD), ensuring smooth daily operations and always delivering a #bestincenter customer experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. Key Responsibilities Leadership & Team Development · Lead the sales floor and oversee daily store operations as Manager on Duty (MOD). · Provides in-the-moment coaching and feedback to elevate performance and team engagement. Communicate performance issues directly to the General Manager/Store Manager. · Support onboarding, training, and development of new associates. Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture. · Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely manner to maintain satisfaction and loyalty. Sales & Business Performance · Support the achievement of store sales goals through effective customer engagement and team motivation. · Maximize selling opportunities by identifying customer needs and offering relevant solutions. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as individual sales volume, average transaction value, and customer conversion rates. Operations & Compliance · Direct employees to ensure appropriate merchandise stock levels and that the selling floor is adequately stocked and merchandised in accordance with visual standards. · Complete inventory transactions including, but not limited to, receiving, MOS (Mark Out of Stock), and RARs (Return Authorization Requests). · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Models and ensures all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs) are communicated effectively to associates, maintained and consistently followed. Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers. · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time. · Ability to move about the store coaching and directing associates; selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel, and crouch to retrieve and replenish merchandise from stockroom or sales floor. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise. · Ability to operate a computer, POS system, keyboards, merchandise scanners and mouse to accomplish work. · Workweeks are expected to be between 20 and 25 hours with the ability to have a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends, and holidays. · Regular and predictable attendance. Qualifications & Experience · Must be 21 years of age or older at the time of employment. · 1 year

databricksventures-replit-com:ashbyhq:23.description: Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation. ABOUT THE ROLE: We’re looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help accelerate the growth of Replit Agent— a core part of our mission to allow anyone to build software, without any coding experience. This role sits at the crossroads of product, engineering, and go-to-market, ensuring that every new feature we ship lands with clarity, excitement, and impact. You’ll work closely with our engineers, PMs and Partnership teams to understand the product roadmap, then translate those innovations into compelling narratives that resonate with builders of all kinds — from solo builders to enterprise teams. You’ll also leverage your storytelling expertise to collaborate with our partner ecosystem, crafting compelling “Better Together” narratives that elevate our joint value and propel partner marketing initiatives. Replit moves fast — we ship continuously, experiment relentlessly, and aim to make every builder more productive and creative. We’re looking for someone who thrives in that environment: part strategist, part storyteller, and part operator. WHAT YOU’LL DO: - Lead Product Marketing for our Launches Develop and operationalize Replit’s launch motion — from early roadmap planning through public release. Create repeatable frameworks that keep launches fast, clear, and coordinated. - Shape Messaging & Positioning Craft technically fluent, developer-first narratives that highlight how Replit’s AI coding agent accelerates creativity and productivity. Tailor messaging to different developer segments and channels. - Create Sales & Growth Enablement Build the first generation of enablement materials (decks, demos, battlecards, FAQs) that empower GTM teams and partners to tell Replit’s story confidently. - Lead Competitive and Market Insights Stay ahead of the fast-moving landscape in AI coding assistants and app development platforms. Identify key trends, threats, and whitespace opportunities that shape how Replit stands out. - Co-market with our Partner ecosystem You’ll also leverage your storytelling expertise to collaborate with our partner ecosystem, crafting compelling “Better Together” narratives that elevate our joint value and propel partner marketing initiatives - Analyze & Learn Define metrics, gather insights, and feed back learnings from the field and community to inform product and marketing strategies. YOU'LL BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU: - Have 8+ years of work experience, including 6+ years in product marketing (ideally within the app development space) - Love building from scratch — frameworks, processes, teams, and strategy - Excellent written communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complexity - Are equally comfortable writing a launch announcement, building a competitive teardown, or running a cross-functional sync - Have a founder mindset: you identify gaps and fill them, move quickly, and don’t wait for someone else to define the playbook - Proven ability to partner directly with engineers and product managers, turning technical concepts into simple, powerful stories - Strong project management skills — you can juggle multiple launches and keep teams aligned under pressure - Experience with sales enablement and competitive positioning for technical audiences - A collaborative, low-ego approach and willingness to dig into the details BONUS POINTS: - Experience in app development space or marketing to product managers, designers, sales, marketing or operations teams - Experience with Partner/Ecosystem Marketing- to start with, we are looking for a generalist who can also help out with Partner Marketing - Experience at a startup or high-growth environment where speed and adaptability matter - Understanding of AI and machine learning technologies

jobgether-jobgether:lever:32ff555c-22ba-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Head of Operations for eCom DTC brand based in Austria. This is a high-impact operations leadership role within a fast-growing, 8-figure direct-to-consumer business. You will take ownership of the operating infrastructure that supports supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, systems, reporting, hiring, and execution. The role is designed for a hands-on builder who can turn operational complexity into clear processes, accountable ownership, and measurable performance. You will identify gaps, build SOPs, establish systems, recruit functional leaders, and create the structure needed for sustainable scale. A major focus will be transitioning day-to-day operational responsibility away from the Founder and toward a capable team of independent functional owners. You will work across distributed teams, vendors, agencies, manufacturers, and operational partners in a highly entrepreneurial environment. Success means building an organization that runs efficiently, solves problems proactively, and no longer depends on you for daily execution. Own end-to-end back-end operations, including supply chain, inventory planning, manufacturing relationships, 3PL and fulfillment, returns, vendor management, and agency coordination. Build and maintain scalable operating systems, processes, and SOPs, ensuring every recurring workflow has clear ownership, documentation, measurement, and accountability. Establish and maintain an operational knowledge base in Notion, continuously improving processes as the business grows and new needs emerge. Develop accurate inventory systems of record, purchase-order calendars, and processes that improve inventory visibility, planning, and stock availability. Build reliable reporting and a single source of truth for weekly leadership metrics, including inventory, stockouts, cost per order, channel and subscription revenue, vendor performance, and other operational KPIs. Create automated subscription and channel revenue reporting and develop a concise weekly operations scorecard for leadership decision-making. Establish vendor and agency scorecards to monitor performance, identify issues, and drive continuous improvement. Identify missing organizational functions, define roles and scorecards, lead recruitment, conduct screening, onboard new hires, and develop functional owners. Build a team of 4–6 functional leaders who can independently own their respective areas and operate without daily intervention. Create repeatable hiring pipelines, work-sample assessments, onboarding systems, and accountability mechanisms. Translate decisions into clear written specifications with defined owners, deadlines, and completion criteria, then follow through until execution is complete. Diagnose operational issues by tracing performance changes back to their underlying causes and implementing sustainable solutions. Continuously identify and resolve operational problems before they escalate into Founder-level issues. Build the infrastructure and organizational capability required to ultimately transition into broader COO-level responsibilities. Requirements At least 3 years of operations experience within a physical-product, e-commerce, or direct-to-consumer business. Experience operating within a high-growth environment, ideally supporting or helping scale a brand generating approximately $20M–$50M in annual revenue. Direct experience across multiple operational functions, including supply chain, inventory, 3PL/fulfillment, customer support operations, creative, and growth teams. Demonstrated experience building a department, function, operating system, hiring process, reporting infrastructure, or other business capability from the ground up. Strong understanding of physical-product operations, including lead times, purchase orders, landed costs, inventory, fulfillment, manufacturing, and 3PL relationships. Pr

jobgether-jobgether:lever:4ec91f71-f5a9-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Solutions & Communications Architect (Fractional Contract) based in France. This is a senior architecture role focused on designing and launching a secure, unified communications and workflow platform. You will lead the architecture from initial discovery through the delivery of a working pilot. The scope spans identity, data protection, integrations, approvals, monitoring, and auditability. You will work with AI-enabled workflows and automated systems while maintaining strong human oversight and security controls. The first month is highly hands-on and fast-paced, with a transition afterward to a lighter ongoing engagement of approximately 8 hours per week. This role offers significant autonomy and ownership, with a strong emphasis on thoughtful engineering and risk management. It is ideal for an experienced architect who can move quickly while knowing when to pause, challenge assumptions, and protect system integrity. Lead the discovery and architecture of a secure, unified communications and workflow environment connecting teams and systems with a central platform. Understand business, technical, security, and operational requirements thoroughly before designing or implementing solutions. Design end-to-end architectures covering identity verification, access controls, data protection, integrations, system connectivity, monitoring, and audit trails. Establish approval checkpoints and human-in-the-loop controls to ensure sensitive communications, actions, and data transfers are properly reviewed before execution. Build and launch a functional pilot within the initial intensive delivery period, including monitoring, backup plans, validation processes, and evidence that the solution operates as intended. Review technical work and deliverables from team members, identifying security, quality, architectural, or completeness concerns and redirecting work when necessary. Document architectural decisions, assumptions, risks, security considerations, and recommended next steps to support long-term scalability and governance. Support the continued maintenance, optimization, and expansion of the platform during the ongoing fractional engagement. Evaluate AI-assisted analysis and design outputs critically, ensuring automated recommendations are independently validated before being incorporated into production solutions. Requirements Senior-level experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, integration architecture, platform architecture, security architecture, or a closely related discipline. Demonstrated experience designing and building AI-enabled workflows, case or work-management platforms, automated systems, or solutions incorporating robust audit trails. Strong knowledge of identity and access management, data protection, least-privilege principles, security controls, and secure system design. Proven experience designing secure environments for multiple clients, organizations, or user groups while maintaining strict data isolation. Experience translating ambiguous or evolving requirements into practical, secure, and scalable technical solutions. Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate research, analysis, architecture, and design while maintaining personal accountability for validating their outputs. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions, risks, and trade-offs clearly to both technical teams and non-technical executives. Ability to work with a high degree of autonomy, make sound technical judgments, and take ownership of quality and security. Experience designing systems for users with varying levels of technical proficiency is a plus. A track record of rapidly turning unclear requirements into safe, functional pilots is highly valued. Willingness to challenge assumptions and stop or escalate work when a solution is not secure, sufficiently

jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf3ba84e-7032-.title: Sr. UI/UX Designer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf3ba84e-7032-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Sr. UI/UX Designer based in Norway. This is a senior design role focused on creating intuitive, polished, and engaging digital experiences across web and mobile products. You’ll work at the intersection of creative design and technical execution, partnering closely with developers and creative teams. The role offers ownership from early concepts and user flows through high-fidelity designs and interactive prototypes. You’ll bring strong visual design fundamentals while considering usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and how products are actually built. AI-powered design tools will be part of the workflow, helping you explore ideas and prototype quickly without compromising quality. You’ll have the opportunity to work on conventional and experimental digital experiences, with room to contribute creative ideas and new approaches. This is a fully remote position requiring strong communication, autonomy, attention to detail, and availability during AEST working hours. Design intuitive, high-quality user interfaces and experiences for web and mobile products, balancing usability, aesthetics, and technical feasibility. Translate briefs, business objectives, and product requirements into user flows, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, and polished digital experiences. Develop interactive prototypes in Figma that effectively communicate user behaviour, interactions, transitions, and overall product experience. Establish and maintain strong visual design systems, applying disciplined grids, spacing, typography, hierarchy, and responsive layouts. Use AI-powered design and creative tools to accelerate ideation, exploration, and rapid prototyping while maintaining a high standard of design quality. Collaborate closely with developers and technical teams throughout the design process to ensure accurate and practical implementation. Present design concepts and decisions clearly to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders, incorporating feedback while confidently explaining design rationale. Take ownership of projects from initial concept through final delivery, identifying problems and developing thoughtful, creative solutions. Help structure and organise design work, documentation, and workflows so projects progress efficiently across distributed teams. Contribute to experimental and innovative digital experiences, including immersive websites, animations, micro-interactions, and other emerging design approaches where relevant. Requirements: 5+ years of professional experience in UI/UX Design, Product Design, Digital Design, or a comparable senior design position. A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent UI/UX capabilities, visual design quality, and creative range, particularly across web experiences. Advanced proficiency in Figma, including interactive prototyping and the ability to communicate complex interactions effectively. Strong understanding of UI/UX principles, usability, information architecture and hierarchy, responsive design, and accessibility fundamentals. Excellent visual design skills, with a deliberate and consistent approach to grids, spacing, typography, composition, and layout. Proven experience collaborating closely with developers or other technical teams and understanding the practical considerations involved in implementation. Ability to take an idea from an initial concept or rough brief through user flows, design exploration, prototyping, and a polished final experience. Strong creative problem-solving skills, curiosity, and the ability to challenge conventional approaches when appropriate. Excellent written and verbal English, with confidence presenting designs and articulating the reasoning behind design decisions. Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and collaborate effectively within a fully remote environment. Familiarity with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus,
